description: Use for the seniority bonus (dodatek stażowy, za wieloletnią pracę, za wysługę lat) in the Polish public sector or under a company pay rule: percent, PLN and the next rise. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Long-service bonus (dodatek stażowy, dodatek za wieloletnią pracę, dodatek za wysługę lat) in Poland from gross monthly base pay and length of counted service: percent and PLN per month and per year today, date and amount of the next rise, the maximum (20%) and when it is reached, the full ladder. Statutory groups: local government employees (samorzad, art. 38: 5% after 5 years, +1% per year, up to 20%; the higher rate is paid from the first day of the next month), civil service (sluzba-cywilna, art. 90), state offices (urzedy-panstwowe, art. 22), court and prosecution staff (sady-prokuratura, art. 15), teachers (nauczyciele, Teachers' Charter art. 33: 1% per year from the fourth year, up to 20%). Private companies: the Labour Code does not provide for the bonus; pass group regulamin with the company rule (start_years, start_pct, step_pct, max_pct). Since 2026 periods of sole proprietorship and mandate contracts can count toward service (Labour Code art. 302^1). Uniformed services have their own pay rules and are not covered.

base_pay.description: Gross monthly base pay (wynagrodzenie zasadnicze), PLN.

group.description: Employee group; regulamin = own company rule.

start.description: Start of counted service, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of years and months).

start_pct.description: regulamin: percent at the start, default 5.

start_years.description: regulamin: full years after which the bonus starts, default 5.

step_pct.description: regulamin: percentage points per further year, default 1.

years.description: Full years of counted service today.

name: calc_seniority_bonus
title: Seniority bonus in Poland (dodatek stażowy)
